task: Restore exact receipt-bound parent closure after an interrupted remote PR reprojection, rejecting foreign state and avoiding manual canonical repair.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Reproducible release executor interrupted transaction: the refreshed PR #1138 (dcc450715b9a...) is newer than canonical persistence head (ad52d8...) because #312 attempt 2 failed after GitHub PR branch mutation but before successful state CAS. finishParentClosurePersistence() checks PR head equality before trusted main reprojection; a normal retry would immediately reject with RELEASE_PARENT_CLOSURE_PR_DRIFT. Must prove a persisted partial remote closure is authentic before allowing a new reprojection, without modifying source or state manually.
observableOutcomes: An executor restart detects stale persisted parent closure PR_HEAD and independently proves a genuine partial remote closure metadata commit before any reprojection.
The accepted remote closure commit has exactly one parent equal to the PR base main, and the PR base must be an ancestor of the current trusted main.
The recovered head changes only canonical active-plan metadata and the exact deterministic parent closure proof artifact.

The persisted CLOSED plan's parentClosureContext matches the immutable source, parent transaction, exact final-main SHA, child closure receipts, and a newly derived trusted main-advance proof; committed artifact bytes equal the independently derived proof.
Fresh canonical proof and newly created closure PR HEAD may be persisted only after exact PR identity and fresh CI, without duplicate U01–U03 operations.
Stale PR without main advance, missing proof, wrong closed plan, foreign head/ref, wrong receipts, extra parents or unsafe base ancestry block with a machine-readable diagnostic.
unresolvedRisks: Remote branch mutation by a third party must never be treated as an interrupted canonical closure.
New main commits can create legitimate drift or protected-file overlap; trusted-main proof must remain authoritative.
Canonical state CAS may fail after PR push; repeated execution must be idempotent or fail closed.
An old PR head may be missing in local clone; explicit remote fetch must not accept an untrusted commit as proven closure.

in: Add proof-bound interrupted closure PR reprojection eligibility before the old PR_HEAD equality guard.
Use exact single-parent commit identity, main ancestry, changed-path set and immutable-source parent proof to classify a remotely refreshed closure.
Require deterministic committed artifact bytes and validate the CLOSED plan against the existing canonical parent receipts and proof context.
Permit trusted reprojection only when current main is a verified descendant of persistence base; do not allow same-main foreign head acceptance.
Emit exact reason/details for invalid or incomplete partial closure without modifying persisted state.
Add adversarial regression tests of an authentic interrupted remote closure and forged, tampered, wrong-parent, absent-proof or no-main-advance cases.
out: No changes to immutable source or historical U01–U03 receipts.
No manual overwrite or softening of canonical state CAS, Truth, Lifecycle, Sentinel, Plan, Edit-Time or CI gates.
No release executor workflow permissions or scheduling changes.
No untrusted PR force update, merge, Builder, Template or Storefront work.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Resuming a durable release after a partially persisted GitHub PR side effect is correctness- and security-critical; acceptance requires exact committed receipt identity, trusted-main proof and adversarial negative tests.

acceptanceCriteria: Plan-only commit passes Plan Before Code before code changes.
An authentic previous closure HEAD with direct main parent, exact metadata-only files and deterministic proof artifact passes reproject eligibility after a newer trusted main appears.
Invalid remote head, foreign PR ref/state, wrong previous base ancestry or no trusted main advance still blocks.
Untrusted CLOSED plan, different immutable source, missing receipt digest or altered committed proof artifact fails closed.
Neither reproject nor CAS is attempted if interrupted closure proof is missing.
Normal PR identity paths where persisted head still matches remain unchanged.
Regression tests exercise delayed external state persistence, exact restarts and malicious alternatives without network requests.
Full CI and Completion Truth on the implementation HEAD, followed by canonical Lifecycle closure and exact PR CI, merge and post-main CI.
Unmodified immutable source release executor resumes all existing U01–U03 receipts, exact parent closure CI and canonical closed receipt; no duplicate unit.
invariants: Every accepted remote HEAD has a single exact parent equal to independently proven previous final main.
Only the declared metadata plan and deterministic parent proof artifact changed in remote closure head.
Parent closure source SHA and all child receipt digests remain immutable across restart.
Any remote identity mismatch not explained by authenticated interrupted reprojection remains a BLOCK.
State is never marked final CLOSED without GitHub merge, CI and canonical receipt.
No second release unit or repeated merge receipt is emitted.

failureModes: GitHub branch force-with-lease succeeds while subsequent state CAS fails.
Remote HEAD diverges from persisted HEAD and previous main had advanced.
Remote metadata commit includes extra files or wrong parent.
Artifact matches local working tree but not committed blob.
Receipt digest in remote context does not match U01–U03 state.
Main not descended from parent closure PR base; protected-file overlap.
Reprojection emits newer commit while main continues changing.
edgeCases: HEAD persisted equals PR head with newer main: original reproject path.
HEAD differs but PR is exact metadata-only successor at prior final main: verified resume.
HEAD differs but PR base equals current main: no new main advance blocks.
HEAD differs and PR body or ref points to another parent transaction.
Missing, malformed or stale proof context and committed artifact.
Same metadata files but source receipt digest changed.
PR head is a merge commit.
Current main advanced past previous closure metadata base.
Network fetch returns unknown PR HEAD commit.

alternatives.summary: Prove the interrupted PR projection from committed metadata and immutable receipt context before allowing trusted main reprojection.
alternatives.reason: Restores interrupted state without accepting foreign heads or manually changing canonical truth.

alternatives.summary: Suppress stale persisted PR head comparison whenever main advances.
alternatives.reason: Allows foreign branch mutation to be overwritten and accepted as part of trusted release.

alternatives.summary: Change canonical release-state JSON to the newer PR HEAD.
Rerun the same failed executor without repair.
alternatives.reason: Already proven to stop at the pre-reproject PR head equality guard.

specialistReviews.finding: An external PR mutation can outlive an uncommitted canonical state transition.
specialistReviews.resolution: Authenticate the partial mutation as a completed metadata-only closure before reconcile.

specialistReviews.finding: A generic reproject on any mismatched PR HEAD would trust attacker-controlled history.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require direct parent, ancestry, allowed diff and deterministic receipt-bound artifact.

specialistReviews.finding: Remote and canonical state refer to different PR HEAD/base after interruption.
specialistReviews.resolution: No canonical persistence until authenticated recovery and new exact remote PR CI.

specialistReviews.finding: Old #9213 action_required PR CI does not authorize closure.
specialistReviews.resolution: Fresh workflow_dispatch CI, exact current HEAD and final main main-ci success required.

specialistReviews.finding: Existing #1141 addressed immediate remote read inconsistency, not durable restart consistency.
specialistReviews.resolution: Track separate failure #1144 with deterministic regression.

challenge.scenario: Remote PR HEAD differs and main advanced: accept without inspecting remote HEAD.
challenge.finding: Would overwrite a foreign PR commit.
challenge.resolution: Prove remote previous closure's committed plan and artifact.

challenge.scenario: PR head has correct-looking file names but wrong source-plan binding.
challenge.finding: Forged parent proof may claim unrelated source.
challenge.resolution: Derive expected parent context from immutable source and canonical receipts.

challenge.scenario: PR closure commit has extra parent.
challenge.finding: Foreign code could be included in parent closure.
challenge.resolution: Require one commit parent exactly equal to PR base.

challenge.scenario: Main advanced through modified child-protected file.
Remote artifact has local-only matching bytes.
challenge.finding: Uncommitted proof could bypass exact persisted evidence.
challenge.resolution: Use git show HEAD:path for exact committed bytes.

challenge.scenario: PR head differs but main equals persisted base.
challenge.finding: No trusted main advance to motivate reprojection.
challenge.resolution: Reject stale or foreign PR head.

challenge.scenario: PR is closed or branch targets foreign base ref.
challenge.finding: An invalid PR could be mistakenly resumed.

challenge.scenario: New reprojected branch passes but state remains stale again.
challenge.finding: Next interrupted retry must remain safely resumable.
challenge.resolution: Repeat deterministic proof under new main and persist state via existing CAS only after exact PR verification.

proofPlan: Commit the plan alone; require canonical Plan Before Code PASS.
Introduce a deterministic interrupted remote closure proof verifier, independent from normal matching-head acceptance.
Require exact single-parent metadata-only diff, source/transaction identity and expected receipt-bound proof artifact bytes.
Authenticate previous PR closure before any newer-main reproject; keep foreign or unchanged-main drift blocked.
Exercise tampered artifact, wrong head/base, extra parent, wrong source, unrelated changed files and duplicate-resume negative tests.
Verify Knowledge, Plan, Edit-Time, Incremental Replay, Quality, TypeScript, Production and Completion Truth against exact implementation HEAD.
Commit the Truth-derived Lifecycle closure and require fresh exact-head PR CI before merge.
Require merged main CI SUCCESS before retrying the original source executor.
Verify successful parent closure PR CI, merge, canonical CLOSED receipt and no duplicate U01–U03 operations; route new blockers through Failure Intake.

requirements.requirement: An interrupted external parent-closure PR refresh must be authenticated against immutable receipts before safe replay or remain blocked, with no canonical truth overwrite.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: An altered or foreign remote PR head must not authorize canonical parent reprojection.
A missing or forged parent proof artifact cannot be accepted as interrupted closure.
A PR head mismatch cannot be ignored unless a strictly newer final main is independently proven.
